targets.query: from(bucket: "HospitalIoT") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r.metric == "heartRate" and r.deviceId =~ /^${deviceId:regex}$/) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "mean")
